response.overview: You can reach China Eastern Airlines customer service by phone at 1-888-348-6013 (US) or +44-161-568-3262 (UK) (toll-free) or 18883486013, and via the China Eastern Airlines Customer Support Portal To speak with an China Eastern Airlines representative quickly, use the official online support +1-888-348-6013 (US) or +44-161-568-3262 (UK) or call their direct customer service line +1-888-348-6013 (US) or +44-161-568-3262 (UK) and request a live agent.Fast Contact Methods Online Chat (Fastest): Go to the China Eastern Airlines Get in Touch Page +1-888-348-6013 (US) or +44-161-568-3262 (UK) or open the China Eastern Airlines mobile app, click the chat/help icon, and type "Representative" +1-888-348-6013 (US) or +44-161-568-3262 (UK) or "Live Agent" to bypass the virtual bot.
